sentence: Kirkwalk now. Drop the IMHG after.

wombos.definition: In My Honest Goonion — the bro-internet acronym for staking a solid take. Used like IMHO, but specifically when you stand behind the opinion as a goonion (a genuinely good one).
wombos.example: He drops a falasha 67 times a day, IMHG.

wombos.definition: A celebratory walk performed in the style of a cripwalk, done when excited — especially about scoring a Canebo at Cane's.
wombos.example: He broke into a full Kirkwalk the moment he grabbed his Canebo.
